run_tune_pid: run the tune_pid script to test PID tuning for a specific LoCoBot joint
run_main: run the main function to sample joint angles and plot the response over time
test_main: test the main function by passing a joint_id argument and verifying angle sampling
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support configurable target angle, time length, and sampling frequency
review_main: review the main function and its use of Robot arm joint position and angle APIs
